name: Noah
summary: An AI chief of staff reached by text and voice rather than an app, which schedules, chases follow-ups and surfaces insights. Pricing and sign-up are not published.

claims.value: Presented as having its own identity and working across your network rather than waiting to be prompted, reached through voice and text instead of an app
Explicitly ruled out: the company states it does not access your screen, keystrokes, passwords or device location, and acts only through connected integrations
Not offered; the company states it does not access your screen or collect screenshots
Voice is a primary channel, alongside phone calls
Described as proactively helping rather than waiting for prompts, but no named scheduling or trigger feature is published
No desktop app; the product is reached through messaging and a web application
No mobile app; the product is reached through messaging
Text messages, RCS, WhatsApp, iMessage, email, Slack and phone calls, plus a web application
Third-party large language model providers, which are not named
Bringing your own key is not described
Not published. The terms state only that certain features may require payment and that fees may change on reasonable notice
Provider-hosted; no component runs on the user's device
A public API is not described
Keeps a copy of connected calendars to stay in sync and stores copies of the messages it works with; no user-facing memory view is described
A right to receive your data in a structured, commonly used format by writing to the company; no in-product export is described
The company states it does not train models on customer data and does not collect screen captures or keystrokes
No self-serve sign-up is published: the site offers only a demo and a login, and users must be eighteen or older

access.detail: No self-serve sign-up or pricing is published; the site offers a demo and a login only. Users must be eighteen or older.

onYourComputer.detail: The company states it does not access your screen, keystrokes, passwords or device location.

agentComputer.detail: No browser or computer of its own: the company states Noah acts only through connected integrations and collects no screenshots.

whileYouAreOff.detail: No component runs on the person's device, so nothing Noah does waits for a computer; the product publishes no named scheduling feature to pin that to.

worksWithoutVendor.detail: Provider-hosted with no component on the user's device. The company has not published what happens if it shuts down.

dataAfterExit.detail: A right to receive your data in a structured, commonly used format by writing to the company.
